renderer: GL Compatibility retained for this pass
goal: make the native Godot 4 game runtime modular, collidable, camera-safe, mobile-friendly, cutscene-safe, and ready for the Lum GLB without destabilizing the proven APK lane

passes.name: source boundary
passes.finding: testing work is isolated from canonical main
passes.mutation: retain branch isolation and rollback snapshot

passes.name: scene composition
passes.finding: Main.tscn is a thin root but main.gd owns nearly every subsystem
passes.mutation: thin orchestrator plus dedicated world/player/HUD/cutscene bridge modules

passes.name: player physics
passes.finding: player capsule exists but the visible ground lacks a StaticBody3D collision surface
passes.mutation: collidable WalkFloor, boundaries and rail collision
passes.gate: runtime smoke verifies player remains supported

passes.name: camera architecture
passes.finding: camera is directly parented to the player and cutscene tweens compete with player view
passes.mutation: yaw/pitch/SpringArm3D rig with owned cutscene tween lifecycle
passes.gate: camera rig path asserted at runtime

passes.name: world composition
passes.finding: Riverwalk and city are mostly decorative primitive meshes
passes.mutation: separate NeonWorld with colliders, emissive rails, arches, city blocks and Lum stage

passes.name: mobile input
passes.finding: D-pad used fixed screen coordinates and no orbit camera
passes.mutation: anchored HUD plus right-side screen-drag orbit

passes.name: cutscene safety
passes.finding: cancel checks occur only between beats and tweens are not centrally owned
passes.mutation: 50 ms interruptible waits plus CutsceneBridge-owned restore boundary

passes.name: mobile rendering
passes.finding: prototype relies on multiple real-time point lights for visual interest
passes.mutation: shift most neon detail to emissive materials and keep a small light budget

passes.name: Lum 3D asset lane
passes.finding: current external luhm.glb is a static mesh with no skin or animations
passes.mutation: stable res://assets/lum/luhm.glb socket with procedural fallback and future animation/blend-shape discovery
passes.gate: asset socket path asserted in CI

passes.name: runtime proof
passes.finding: CI proves parse/export/APK integrity but did not instantiate and exercise the game scene
passes.mutation: headless runtime smoke before APK export
passes.gate: runtime smoke + aapt + apksigner + zipalign + SHA-256

promotion: Crown green means candidate evidence is green; canonical main promotion remains a separate human Crown action
